description: Machine-readable dictionary for every key in network_results.json: units, formula, the published name and abbreviation, biological meaning and caveats. Rendered to docs/metrics.md by scripts/build_metrics_doc.py. tests/test_metrics_dictionary.py fails if a detector emits a key that is missing here.

vocabularies.Mossink et al. 2021 Stem Cell Reports: MFR, PRS, BR, BD, BSR, IBI, NBR, NBD, NIBI, CV_NIBI, RT, DT
vocabularies.MaxLab Live (MaxWell): SPB, BD, BP, IBI, bISI, BF, each with a CV
vocabularies.Axion / Multiwell: burst peak, network burst participation, number of spikes per network burst

population_rate_per_unit.note: Mean firing rate per active unit. Matches MaxWell's mxw.networkActivity.computeNetworkAct. Source of burst_area_spikes_per_unit and burst_peak_hz_per_unit. Exposed in plot_data as population_firing_rate_hz, a name fixed by the plotting signature.

population_rate_total.note: Unsmoothed array-wide spike rate. Rises with unit yield, so it is not comparable across wells. Source of burst_peak_hz_array only.

coactivity.note: Per-bin co-activity: how many units fired at least once in the bin, over the number of units active anywhere in the recording. Saturates at one spike per unit per bin, so firing harder cannot raise it. This is the detection signal, and it is the field's convention (QSpike >=30% of active electrodes, Bakkum 2013 >=25%, Kaufman & Ziv 40%, Axion 50%, le Feber 60%). Exposed as coactive_fraction_signal in plot_data.

mean_firing_rate_hz.definition: Firing rate of one unit over the whole recording.
mean_firing_rate_hz.literature: Mossink et al. 2021 Stem Cell Reports
mean_firing_rate_hz.caveat: Before schema 2 the denominator was the span between first and last spike, inflating the rate in a well quiet at either end.

isi_cv.definition: Global irregularity of a unit's inter-spike intervals.
isi_cv.literature: Riccio et al. 2025; Gu et al. 2025
isi_cv.caveat: Confounded by rate non-stationarity: a unit that speeds up across the recording scores high without being irregular. Prefer cv2 or lv.

cv2.definition: Local irregularity from adjacent interval pairs; 1.0 for a Poisson process.

lv.definition: Local variation. 1.0 Poisson, above 1 bursty, below 1 regular.
lv.literature: Shinomoto et al. 2009 PLoS Comput Biol 5:e1000433

log_isi_bimodality.definition: Sarle bimodality coefficient of the log-ISI distribution. Above 0.555 suggests separate intra-burst and inter-burst interval populations.
log_isi_bimodality.literature: Sarle 1990 (SAS); cutoff 0.555 is the SAS convention; cf. peak of log(ISI) histogram in Riccio et al. 2025

is_bursty_by_isi_statistics.formula: log_isi_bimodality > 0.555 AND (lv is null OR lv > 1.0)
is_bursty_by_isi_statistics.definition: Whether a unit's own interval statistics look bursty. A statistical criterion, not a count of detected bursts.
is_bursty_by_isi_statistics.caveat: Load-bearing and unvalidated: the pooled log-ISIs of these units set reference_isi_s, which sets bin_size_ms and both merge gaps.

start_time_s.formula: bin edge where the co-activity signal last rose above max(detection_threshold, extent_frac * peak)

end_time_s.formula: bin edge where the co-activity signal fell back below that level

burst_duration_s.definition: Burst width. At merged tiers this spans the gaps between components.
burst_duration_s.literature: Mossink et al. 2021; BD in MaxLab Live
burst_duration_s.definition_biology: Prolonged bursts indicate impaired termination: weakened inhibition, reduced adaptation or slower AHP.
burst_duration_s.caveat: Edges sit at a fraction of each burst's own peak, so this is not time above an absolute level. Conventions differ (QSpike 80% of max, Kaufman & Ziv 10% of threshold, here 30% of peak).

peak_time_s.formula: bin centre of the co-activity peak; at merged tiers the peak of the highest component

rise_time_s.definition: Time from burst onset to its peak.
rise_time_s.definition_biology: Recruitment speed: how fast the network is drawn into the burst. Dissociates from duration in several disease models.
rise_time_s.caveat: At merged tiers this is measured from the merged onset, so it grows when fragments merge. Compare within a tier.

decay_time_s.definition: Time from the peak to burst offset.
decay_time_s.definition_biology: Termination dynamics. Mossink found DT among the parameters most sensitive to batch, so it is informative but needs batch in the model.
decay_time_s.caveat: At merged tiers measured to the merged offset; see rise_time_s.

participation_fraction.formula: units firing at least once in [start_time_s, end_time_s) / n_units, recounted from raw spike times
participation_fraction.definition: Breadth of recruitment across the whole burst.
participation_fraction.literature: Bakkum et al. 2013 Nat Commun (>=25% of electrodes); Riccio et al. 2025; QSpike Tools (>=30%)
participation_fraction.definition_biology: Falls when part of the network decouples from the burst while the rest keeps bursting.
participation_fraction.caveat: Not derived from the binned signal. A 2 s burst can reach 0.9 participation while never exceeding 0.15 co-activity in any single bin, which is sequential recruitment rather than synchrony.

coactive_fraction_peak.definition: Largest fraction of units co-active within one bin. Simultaneity, not breadth.
coactive_fraction_peak.literature_name: synchrony ratio / fraction of active electrodes
coactive_fraction_peak.literature: Kaufman et al. 2014 (Sync Ratio); Riccio et al. 2025 (smoothed active fraction)
coactive_fraction_peak.definition_biology: Desynchronisation phenotypes move this while leaving participation_fraction flat.
coactive_fraction_peak.caveat: Bin-resolution simultaneity (20-100 ms), not millisecond. Smoothed, so a local average rather than a literal count; coactive_fraction_max is raw.

coactive_fraction_max.formula: max(active_unit_counts over the burst) / n_units, unsmoothed
coactive_fraction_max.definition: Highest single-bin co-activity anywhere in the burst, from raw counts.
coactive_fraction_max.definition_biology: The honest simultaneity number; the detector also uses it to reject events that only look synchronous after smoothing.

burst_peak_hz_per_unit.definition: Peak firing rate per active unit during the burst.
burst_peak_hz_per_unit.literature: MaxLab Live; Axion ('peak of the average network burst histogram divided by bin size')
burst_peak_hz_per_unit.definition_biology: Burst amplitude: how hard the participating neurons fire at the height of the burst.
burst_peak_hz_per_unit.caveat: MEANING CHANGED IN SCHEMA 3. Before, the adaptive detector put the array-wide sum under the old name while the Gaussian detector put the per-unit rate, so the same key differed between detectors by a factor of n_units.

burst_peak_hz_array.formula: max(population_rate_total over the burst); in the Gaussian detector burst_peak_hz_per_unit * n_units
burst_peak_hz_array.definition: Peak array-wide spike rate during the burst.
burst_peak_hz_array.caveat: Rises with unit yield. Kept only for comparison against platform software that reports the array-wide value; do not compare across wells without n_units as a covariate.

burst_area_spikes_per_unit.definition: Integral of the per-unit population rate across the burst: amplitude and width in one number.
burst_area_spikes_per_unit.literature: Axion (area under the normalised network burst)
burst_area_spikes_per_unit.caveat: Nearly independent of the smoothing sigma, because Gaussian convolution preserves the integral. Before schema 3 merged tiers summed component areas, skipping the gaps that burst_duration_s spans.

spikes_per_burst.definition: Spikes inside the burst, summed over all units.
spikes_per_burst.literature: MaxLab Live; 'spikes per network burst' in Gu et al. 2025
spikes_per_burst.caveat: NOT divided by n_units, so it rises with unit yield. Use spikes_per_burst_per_unit across wells. Before schema 3 merged tiers summed components, excluding inter-component gaps.

spikes_per_burst_per_unit.definition_biology: Total output of the average neuron per burst; the comparable version of spikes_per_burst.

intraburst_rate_hz.definition: Firing rate inside the burst, per unit that took part.
intraburst_rate_hz.literature: Mossink et al. 2021; 'intra-burst firing frequency' in Fifield-Smith et al. 2025
intraburst_rate_hz.definition_biology: Intensity free of both duration and yield: separates 'bursts got longer' from 'neurons fired harder within them'.
intraburst_rate_hz.caveat: Computed since schema 1 to gate detection via min_burst_density_Hz, but discarded before being reported.

intraburst_isi_mean_s.formula: mean(diff(all spikes inside the burst window)), pooled across units
intraburst_isi_mean_s.definition: Mean interval between consecutive spikes inside the burst.
intraburst_isi_mean_s.definition_biology: Falls as a burst becomes internally denser; a within-burst counterpart to the inter-burst interval.
intraburst_isi_mean_s.requires: at least 2 spikes in the window, else null

superburst_type.formula: 'elongated' when a network burst lasts longer than elongated_min_dur_s; 'cluster' when several network bursts are grouped across superburst_gap_s
superburst_type.definition: Kind of superburst. Elongated: one prolonged network burst, typically many merged fragments. Cluster: a train of separate network bursts. An elongated burst inside a cluster is reported only as part of the cluster.
superburst_type.literature: Cluster definition from Wagenaar et al. 2006

n_components.formula: number of events merged at this tier
n_components.definition: Immediate children: fragments for a network burst, network bursts for a superburst.

n_fragments.formula: transitive sum of component fragment counts
n_fragments.definition: Burst fragments contained at any depth. Equals n_components at the network burst tier; at the superburst tier it counts fragments while n_components counts network bursts.
n_fragments.definition_biology: Internal fragmentation: activity dipping below threshold mid-burst without reaching silence.

burst_count.definition: Number of events in this tier. Always a real number, so a well with no bursts is distinguishable from one with undefined metrics.

burst_rate_hz.literature: Chiappalone et al. 2005; Mossink et al. 2021
burst_rate_hz.caveat: Before schema 2 the denominator was the spike span, inflating the rate in wells quiet at either end.

burst_rate_per_min.definition: The same rate in the unit the literature quotes.
burst_rate_per_min.literature: Mossink et al. 2021 define NBR per minute; well gates are quoted as >0.4 bursts/min and >1 network burst/min
burst_rate_per_min.caveat: Added so a per-minute threshold is never compared against a Hz value.

burst_duration_p95_s.definition_biology: A culture shifting from many short bursts to a few long ones can leave the mean unchanged while this moves.

duty_cycle.definition: Fraction of recording time the network spends inside a burst.
duty_cycle.definition_biology: Rises both when bursts lengthen and when they come closer together, so it summarises excitability without committing to a model fit.

ibi_s.definition: Inter-burst interval, ONSET TO ONSET: the burst cycle period, which includes the burst itself. Network burst tier.
ibi_s.literature: Mossink et al. 2021; Wagenaar et al. 2006
ibi_s.requires: at least 2 events, else all fields null
ibi_s.definition_biology: Recovery between bursts. Its CV is the standard rhythmicity index and one of the strongest discriminators reported in ID/ASD models (Frega et al. 2020).

ifbi_s.definition: As ibi_s, for the burst fragment tier.

isbi_s.definition: As ibi_s, for the superburst tier.

ibi_gap_s.definition: Inter-burst interval, OFFSET TO ONSET: the silent gap. Diverges from ibi_s when bursts are long.
ibi_gap_s.literature: Mossink et al. 2021 compute NIBI offset-to-onset; Axion convention
ibi_gap_s.caveat: Clipped at 0 so nested or overlapping tiers cannot contribute negative silences.

ifbi_gap_s.definition: As ibi_gap_s, for the burst fragment tier.

isbi_gap_s.definition: As ibi_gap_s, for the superburst tier.

n_spikes_in_network_bursts.formula: spikes falling inside the merged union of network burst windows
n_spikes_in_network_bursts.definition: Spikes inside network bursts; overlapping windows merged first so none is double counted.

fraction_spikes_in_network_bursts.definition: Share of spiking that is organised into network bursts.
fraction_spikes_in_network_bursts.literature_name: fraction of spikes within a network burst
fraction_spikes_in_network_bursts.literature: Riccio et al. 2025; network burst proportion in Verboven et al. 2025

percent_random_spikes.definition: Share of spiking that happens outside any network burst.
percent_random_spikes.literature: Mossink et al. 2021, one of their core parameters
percent_random_spikes.definition_biology: A culture can hold its burst rate while its neurons drift out of the bursts; only this ratio shows that.

schema_version.definition: Version of this metric schema; see burst_common.SCHEMA_VERSION. Absent means a file written before versioning.

detector.caveat: Check before pooling wells: the two detectors do not populate the same tiers.

analysis_window_s.definition: Span between the first and last spike; sets the binning window.

duration_source.definition: 'recording' if the true duration reached the detector, 'spike_span' if it fell back to the active span and every rate is therefore inflated.

burst_detection_valid.definition: False means the numbers in this file are not meaningful. Filter on this first.

n_units.definition: Units with at least one spike anywhere in the recording, after curation.
n_units.caveat: Not a passive covariate: it is the denominator of the co-activity signal and it sets min_units_for_burst and the threshold percentile. Plot it by group before interpreting any burst metric.

bin_size_ms.definition: Bin width for every population signal; defines what 'simultaneous' means.
bin_size_ms.caveat: Adapts per well. Two wells with different bin sizes were measured with different definitions of synchrony.

reference_isi_s.definition: Biological interval scale driving bin size and the fragment merge gap.

reference_isi_source.definition: bursty_peak, all_percentile15 or default, in descending order of evidence.

coactive_fraction_baseline.definition: Baseline co-activity the threshold is built from.
coactive_fraction_baseline.caveat: Also echoed into plot_data for the baseline line on the trace; the Gaussian detector reports the mean rather than the median there.

coactive_fraction_mad.definition: Robust spread of the co-activity signal.

coactive_fraction_bimodality.definition: Sarle bimodality coefficient of the co-activity signal; selects the threshold method rather than gating detection, because sparse bursting gives a low value even when real.

detection_threshold.formula: max(0.03, baseline + 0.75*MAD) if coactive_fraction_bimodality > 0.555 else max(0.03, percentile(signal, 95 + 5*exp(-n_units/50)))
detection_threshold.definition: Co-activity level a peak had to exceed.
detection_threshold.literature: adaptive thresholding per Valkki et al. 2017 Front Comput Neurosci 11:40
detection_threshold.caveat: Adapts per well; audit it against experimental group before reporting a phenotype. Also echoed into plot_data as the line drawn on the trace, where the Gaussian detector puts null because its threshold is in Hz (see detection_threshold_hz).

threshold_source.definition: baseline_mad, or pNN.N naming the percentile used instead.

min_coactive_fraction.definition: Raw single-bin co-activity a fragment had to reach to be kept.

min_units_for_burst.definition: Absolute co-active unit floor behind min_coactive_fraction.

superburst_min_dur_s.definition: Minimum duration of a cluster superburst. 0 means no minimum.
superburst_min_dur_s.caveat: Defaulted to 2.5 s before schema 5 and was attributed to Wagenaar et al. 2006. That paper defines superbursts by interval contrast and states no duration, so the 2.5 s had no source and was removed.

superburst_min_components.definition: Minimum network bursts in a cluster superburst, default 2.
superburst_min_components.literature: Wagenaar et al. 2006 define superbursts as clusters of bursts; the minimum of 2 is this pipeline's convention
superburst_min_components.caveat: Effectively 1 before schema 2, so every network burst longer than superburst_min_dur_s was also reported as a superburst. Superburst counts from schema 1 files are not comparable.

sigma_coactivity_bins.definition: Gaussian smoothing width applied to the co-activity signal, 1-2 bins.

sigma_firing_rate_bins.definition: Gaussian smoothing width applied to the per-unit rate, 3-8 bins; wider because the rate is an unbounded count while co-activity is bounded and pre-averaged.
sigma_firing_rate_bins.caveat: Affects the drawn trace and little else: burst_area_spikes_per_unit is an integral, which Gaussian convolution preserves.

method.definition: gaussian_population_rate_mean_plus_sd, or ..._no_height_gate when the height gate is disabled.

gaussian_sigma_s.definition: Smoothing kernel sigma, default 0.1 s. Mirrors MATLAB GaussianSigma.

baseline_mean_hz.formula: mean(smoothed rate over the whole trace)
baseline_mean_hz.caveat: Taken over the whole trace including bursts, so it rises with burst load. The literature convention, deliberately kept, but not a pure baseline.

baseline_std_hz.definition: Standard deviation behind the height gate; same whole-trace caveat as baseline_mean_hz.

min_height_sd.definition: Height gate in units of baseline_std_hz, default 2.0; None disables it.
min_height_sd.literature: Chiappalone et al. 2005 use mean + N*SD
min_height_sd.caveat: Added in schema 2. Without it a silent well still yielded network bursts.

detection_threshold_hz.definition: Rate a peak had to exceed.

min_prominence_hz.definition: Peak prominence requirement; defaults to baseline_std_hz.

onset_offset_peak_frac.definition: Burst edges sit where the smoothed rate falls to this fraction of the peak.
onset_offset_peak_frac.caveat: Before schema 2 the code used peak*(1-frac) instead of peak*frac, making durations roughly three times too short.

edge_rule.definition: fraction_of_peak. Records which edge convention produced the durations.

time_s.definition: Bin centres for every trace in plot_data.

coactive_fraction_signal.definition: The per-bin co-activity trace: the detection signal.
coactive_fraction_signal.caveat: plot_data keys are splatted into helper.plot_clean_network as keyword arguments, so they must match that signature exactly.

population_firing_rate_hz.definition: The smoothed per-unit population rate trace.
population_firing_rate_hz.caveat: Name kept to match helper.plot_clean_network's parameter. Per unit, not an array-wide sum.

sb_start_times_s.definition: Superburst onsets; empty for the Gaussian detector.

sb_end_times_s.definition: Superburst offsets; empty for the Gaussian detector.

fragment_merge_rule.definition: How fragments were merged into network bursts: 'continuity' (default), 'gap' (proximity only, the comparison condition matching published detectors) or 'none'.

merge_floor.definition: Level of the co-activity signal that the network must stay at or above between two fragments for them to merge into one network burst: the 25th percentile of the co-activity signal.
merge_floor.caveat: The 25th percentile rather than the median, because the median is lifted by the bursts themselves. A signal that is exactly zero never counts as continuous.

fragment_max_gap_s.definition: Optional safety cap on how far apart two fragments may be and still merge. None by default: the continuity rule needs no gap, because fragments end at a fraction of their own peak and the question is only whether the trough between them crossed the detection threshold.
fragment_max_gap_s.caveat: Earlier versions gated this tier on the 95th percentile of within-burst SPIKE intervals from single units, 2-16 ms, against sub-burst pauses of 80-500 ms. No two fragments were ever that close, so the tier merged nothing and n_fragments was 1 for every event.

nb_gap_bimodality.formula: Sarle bimodality coefficient of log10(gaps), each gap from the END of one network burst to the START of the next
nb_gap_bimodality.definition: Whether this well's network bursts are clustered in time. Above 0.555 means two gap populations, within-cluster and between-cluster. None when there are fewer than 8 gaps.
nb_gap_bimodality.literature: Sarle 1990; cluster definition from Wagenaar et al. 2006

superburst_gap_s.formula: 10 ** otsu_threshold(log10(gaps)) when the gaps are bimodal, else the geometric midpoint of the largest sorted-gap jump when it is at least 10x, else None
superburst_gap_s.definition: Largest gap, from the end of one network burst to the start of the next, across which network bursts are grouped into a cluster superburst. None when there is no cluster structure; elongated superbursts are still reported.
superburst_gap_s.literature: Otsu 1979; Wagenaar et al. 2006 (inter-cluster intervals at least 10x the intra-cluster ones)
superburst_gap_s.caveat: Earlier versions measured the interval between fragment starts, tested it with a histogram antimode and fell back to a hardcoded 0.75 s, so superbursts appeared in regularly bursting cultures.

superburst_gap_source.definition: nb_gap_otsu, wagenaar_10x_break, no_cluster_structure (no cluster superbursts), too_few_network_bursts, or user_override.

elongated_min_dur_s.definition: Duration above which a network burst is reported as an elongated superburst.
elongated_min_dur_s.caveat: A convention of this pipeline; no standard value was found in the literature.

stats_fields.description: Tier metrics derived from a per-event field are reported as an object rather than a scalar.
stats_fields.mean: arithmetic mean, or null when no event defined the field
stats_fields.cv: std/mean, or null when the mean is within 1e-12 of zero
stats_fields.null_convention: A well with no bursts has an undefined mean, reported as null rather than 0.0. Before schema 2 these were zeros, which dragged group means down and made a silent well look like one with very short bursts. burst_count is always a real number, so the two cases are distinguishable.
